release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.55 completes the Settings redesign by unifying the interiors of all eight Settings destinations. Account, Appearance, Updates, Guides, Orders, Automation, Operations and Diagnostics now share the same compact Obsidian control-surface language for section headers, telemetry rows, cards, fields, buttons, consoles, dividers, spacing and responsive behavior. Existing controls, pane IDs, callbacks, routing, data bindings and persistence remain intact; this release is a presentation-layer refresh rather than a functional rewrite. The Settings interior changes were validated with UI/runtime contracts, DOM tests, Go tests, Linux security preflight, Windows native build and WebView2 boot, CodeQL, real Chromium E2E and the 120-task soak before release.
